data.name: Sunset Atlantia
data.headline: For all ages! • 2 Hours • Sunset cruise $2000
data.description:
Atlantia is a 64’ power catamaran sporting a 33 foot beam. Atlantia features an amazing six state rooms and six bathrooms, plus crew quarters, accommodating up to 12 people overnight as well as 12 on a day charter. This is a gorgeous catamaran that provides a smooth ride for an unforgettable charter experience.

Atlantia boasts a spacious, fully equipped galley, with a large island, an industrial dishwasher, a new enhanced hood for the full sized range and oven, and a double bay sink. Her salon features a large retractable TV, a lounge/dining space with 2 convertible tables, and comfort beyond any other catamaran out on the water. The spacious all teak decks, lounge areas on her bow and stern provide ample space for a relaxing and luxurious charter. Atlantia’s outdoor accommodations are unmatched with two outdoor refrigerators, sinks, and an ice maker. Her helm is equipped with state of the art navigational equipment and cutting edge technology. This is the perfect yacht to entertain, and guarantees the most desirable experience on the water.
